question: According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), in October 2025, severe cyclonic storm "Montha" crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast between which two locations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Machilipatnam and Kalingapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** monitored the development of a deep depression in the **Bay of Bengal**, which intensified into the severe cyclonic storm named **"Montha"** in **October 2025**.
 
• The storm made its official landfall along the **Andhra Pradesh** coast, specifically crossing the shoreline between the administrative and geographical landmarks of **Machilipatnam** and **Kalingapatnam**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Machilipatnam and Kalingapatnam.***
 
• During the landfall process, the **wind speeds** associated with **Montha** were recorded at significant levels, categorizing it as a **Severe Cyclonic Storm** under the standard **IMD classification** scales.
